findingClass: the closed-IPO job records an IPO DONE although an extractable document it was selected for is still unread (PENDING, FAILED awaiting retry, or IN_PROGRESS from a crashed run) -- the IPO is then dropped from the backlog for good (#717)
failThreshold: any closed_ipo_resourcing row with outcome = 'DONE' whose IPO holds a documents row of type PRICE_BAND_AD/RHP/DRHP/PROSPECTUS with extraction_status NOT IN ('COMPLETED', 'MANUAL_REVIEW', 'NOT_EXTRACTABLE') (NULL counts as unread), whatever fields_written is; reported by IPO name
unverifiableWhen: closed_ipo_resourcing does not exist on the slot (migration 0050 not applied)
